approval_policy.description: Codex's AskForApproval. untrusted: only known-safe read commands run unasked. on-request (the default): the model asks via sandbox_permissions when it needs escalation; on-failure is its alias, as in Codex. never: nothing is ever asked, refusals are returned to the model.

rules.description: Codex execpolicy rules: a command prefix and what to do when a sub-command matches it. Every sub-command of a call must be covered for the rule decision to apply.

auto_compact_limit_chars.description: Compact when the serialized conversation reaches this many characters. Codex fires at 90% of the model's context window; 400000 chars is that, roughly, for a 128k-token window.
